description: A left-to-right diagram. On the LEFT, a vertical column of five equal rounded cards, each with a bold first word and a short second line: 'Manual' / 'the Run button'; 'Schedule' / 'every Monday 09:00'; 'Event' / 'stock falls below reorder level'; 'Form' / 'Neha fills: goods arrived'; 'Chat or email' / 'a dealer writes in'. Five thin arrows converge from the cards into ONE rounded box on the RIGHT labelled 'Trigger node' with a subtitle 'starts one run, with its data'. From that box one arrow continues right into a short chain of two faint boxes 'Node' -> 'Node' to suggest the rest of the workflow. Cards in light sky tint, the trigger box solid sky blue with white text. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.

An annotated workflow diagram, left to right, with callout labels in green pointing at each part. The workflow: a rounded pill 'Monday 09:00' (callout 'Trigger') -> box 'Check stock' (callout 'Node') -> a diamond 'Below reorder?' (callout 'Condition') with two exits labelled 'true' and 'false'; the 'false' exit goes down to a small grey box 'Skip'. The 'true' exit goes to box 'Raise PR' -> box 'Rohit approves' drawn in ember tint with a small pause symbol made of two short vertical bars (callout 'Approval: a saved wait') -> box 'Create PO' -> box 'Release'. The arrow between 'Raise PR' and 'Rohit approves' carries a small monospace label 'request_no' (callout 'Data mapping'). One arrow (callout 'Edge') is plain. From 'Create PO' a thin ember dashed arrow labelled 'error' leads down to a box 'Message Kavita' (callout 'Error path'). Keep the callouts outside the chain so nothing overlaps. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.

A horizontal timeline with two lanes. TOP lane labelled 'Run' shows rounded boxes left to right: 'Mon 10:02 · run starts' -> 'Raise PR · PR/2026/04417' -> 'Approval node · status: waiting' (ember tint) -> a long gap drawn as a dotted line labelled 'hours or days · nothing held in memory' -> 'Resume · re-read status from Bahi' -> 'Create PO · PO/2026/01182' -> 'Release'. BOTTOM lane labelled 'Rohit' shows a single box 'Approves in his inbox' positioned under the right end of the dotted gap, with a thin arrow up into 'Resume'. Under the 'Approval node' box a downward arrow into a cylinder 'Run store · one JSON document', and from the cylinder an arrow up into 'Resume'. Calm, precise, plenty of whitespace. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.

Two horizontal rows, one above the other, sharing a single box on the right. TOP row labelled 'Run 1': box 'Raise PR' -> box 'key = hash(KJOSHI, GSK-SIL-05L, 20000, PRD-07, 2026-11-09)' in monospace green tint -> box 'No PR with this key · save PR/2026/04417'. BOTTOM row labelled 'Run 2 · same workflow, same Rasoi': box 'Raise PR' -> the same key box -> box 'Found PR/2026/04417 · already_done: true' in sky tint. Both rows end in one shared box on the far right 'Bahi: exactly one PR'. A small note under the bottom row: 'Re-running must not double-order'. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.

A diagram that zooms into one node. TOP: a small horizontal workflow strip of three boxes 'Chat trigger' -> 'Agent node' -> 'Message Rohit', where 'Agent node' is solid sky blue. From 'Agent node' two thin lines fan down to a large rounded panel below that shows its inside. Inside the panel, on the LEFT, three stacked input cards: 'Instructions' / 'plain words: what it is for', 'Tools' / 'a chosen few of the 15', 'Model' / 'gemini-3.8-flash'. They feed into the CENTRE, a loop drawn as a circle of three labelled arcs: 'model reads' -> 'calls a tool' -> 'reads the result' -> back to 'model reads', with a small label 'max 12 steps'. On the RIGHT an output card 'Reply + list of tool calls'. A small green label under the panel: 'The Lecture 5 loop, inside one node'. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.

A left-to-right architecture diagram. LEFT: a document card 'Workflow JSON' with two monospace lines 'nodes: [...]' and 'edges: [...]'. CENTRE: a large rounded box 'Engine' containing four stacked numbered steps: '1  Find the ready nodes', '2  Fill templates from earlier outputs', '3  Run the node', '4  Write the run log', with a curved arrow from step 4 back up to step 1 labelled 'until nothing is ready'. A side exit from the Engine box, in ember, labelled 'Approval waiting: save the run, stop'. RIGHT: two boxes stacked with an arrow between them: 'Toolbox · 15 tools · as Kavita, Rohit or Neha' (sky tint) above 'Bahi ERP 7.2' (ember tint, grey window style). BELOW the Engine: a cylinder 'Run store' with arrows to and from the Engine. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.

A left-to-right system diagram with four columns. Column 1: a rounded browser-window shape labelled 'Workflow Studio' containing three small labelled regions 'Palette', 'Canvas', 'Run panel'. Column 2: a document card 'Workflow JSON' with arrows to and from column 1 labelled 'save' and 'run'. Column 3: a box 'Studio engine' with a small cylinder beneath it 'Runs and waits'. Column 4: a box 'Toolbox · the same 15 tools as Ask Rasoi' above a box 'Your own Rasoi · Bahi ERP 7.2' (ember tint). Along the bottom, a thin green line spanning columns 3-4 labelled 'every write: preview, confirm, idempotency key, the person's own permissions'. Sky blue for the new parts. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font.
